beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore considers overlapping adoption paths rather than one universal curve.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different segments can face different costs, norms, incentives, and moments of readiness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also examines how users learn techniques through the tools and one another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read these chapters to understand why uneven adoption can persist without being contradictory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book then introduces a cost that immediate productivity can leave invisible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If assistance removes learning experiences, today's output may conceal tomorrow's missing competence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It calls this possibility apprenticeship debt, rather than assuming every shortcut causes harm.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Some routine tasks teach little, while others develop judgment needed to catch mistakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The difficult question is which abilities transfer when the assistance is removed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This chapter gives managers and educators a reason to measure learning alongside completed work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An adoption framework becomes weak if every outcome can be explained afterward.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore revisits technologies whose promised inevitability failed to arrive as expected.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These cases challenge the reader to identify missing conditions and misleading signals.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its later forecasts remain conditional applications of the argument, rather than established future facts.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful assessment must allow not yet, not this segment, or not this form.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That discipline makes the book more demanding than a collection of enthusiastic adoption stories.
